content.text: I’ll inspect the issue service, event handlers, and notification preferences, then implement the hierarchy behavior and run the relevant checks.
The existing repository paginates issue lists, so I’m adding an unpaginated project-scoped hierarchy read to ensure roll-ups and archive cascades cover every descendant.

input.command: /bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'issue_assigned|digest_ready' src | head -80; cat package.json; cat src/config/constants.ts"
